O H3C H N CH3 O 116 Analgesics Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Antipyretics Prolonged use of large doses of analgesic mixtures containing phenacetin has been associated with the development of renal papillary necrosis (see Effects on the Kidneys, p.98) and transi- tional-cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis. Porphyria. Phenacetin is considered to be unsafe in patients with porphyria because it has been shown to be porphyrinogenic in animals.
